name: Fabrication Toolkit Color
description_full:
Fork of Fabrication Toolkit (Benny Megidish, Apache-2.0) that can add a full-colour PNG/JPG image to the top and/or bottom face for JLCPCB's 'EasyEDA multi-color silkscreen' option.

Colour files are produced with an unofficial, reverse-engineered format (port of TransJLC by HalfSweet, Apache-2.0). JLCPCB officially accepts colour files from EasyEDA Pro only: check the JLCPCB Gerber Viewer before ordering.

Without image the output is identical to Fabrication Toolkit.

0.2.0: visual placement editor (top and bottom views, move/resize/rotate); the image is clipped to the closed Edge.Cuts outline before export.
